Market today: The market's mood is cautious after the U.S. unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July, signaling a potential economic slowdown. This directly impacts your growth-oriented tech and chip names, as a weaker economy can curb demand.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a painful -46.32% and SPAL is down -48.55%. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns hurt extra on margin and they decay over time. These need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader economic data following the jobs report, and monitor the rising volatility in memory stocks, which directly affects your chip exposure.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions in this uncertain economic climate.
plays: SOXL: Consider adjusting your stop loss or trimming this leveraged position given the -46.32% loss and economic headwinds.
SPAL: Review your stop loss or trim this new, highly volatile leveraged ETF, currently down -48.55%.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The economic data and chip volatility don't support adding new positions right now.
